content:
Inventory and organize the uploaded reference files at /var/www/projects/nexifynewweb root:

1. Create /var/www/projects/nexifynewweb/.reference/ folder if not exists
2. List ALL files at the project root (HTML, PNG, PDF, JS, anything else)
3. Identify the main reference: indexnewnexify.html (the design to mirror)
4. Move/copy each uploaded file to its proper home:
   - PNG images → images/ (keep originals as reference too)
   - PDF files → assets/pdf/
   - JS files → js/ (keep originals as reference too)
   - HTML files → keep at .reference/ as the source of truth for layout/content
5. Create .reference/INVENTORY.md listing every uploaded file with its purpose (design reference, asset, script, etc.)
6. DO NOT modify or delete any uploaded file — only copy/organize

This ticket only ORGANIZES. Building the site happens in later tickets.
